title: Fractional Powers of Operators: Characterization via $δ$-Regularized Logarithmic Representation
summary: For the fractional powers of operators, the classical formulation by V. Balakrishnan inherently requires positivity or specific sectorial conditions of the generator (i.e., the generation of analytic semigroups). To overcome these limitations, this paper presents a novel approach to constructing fractional powers of operators $D^k$ through the $δ$-regularized logarithmic representation of infinitesimal generators $D$, based on the framework of $C^0$-semigroup theory for abstract evolution equations in Banach spaces.
